name: overnight_vol_carry_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: The overnight return variance (close-to-open) is systematically different from intraday return variance (open-to-close) in Indian equities. On average, the ratio of overnight vol to intraday vol for NIFTY 50 stocks is ~0.6, meaning stocks move less overnight than during the session. However, after nights with abnormally high overnight vol (gap > 1.5 * normal overnight range), the intraday session tends to mean-revert — the overnight move was an overshoot. Conversely, after abnormally LOW overnight vol (gap < 0.3 * normal), the intraday session tends to be directional (pent-up energy release). The strategy trades the intraday session based on the overnight vol ratio. This exploits the overnight-intraday vol relationship that most traders ignore.
stock_filter: daily avg volume > ₹200cr; must have 20+ day overnight/intraday vol history
indicators: session_type = 'mean_rev' if overnight_ratio > 1.5 else 'momentum' if overnight_ratio < 0.3 else 'neutral'

conditions: IF session_type == 'mean_rev': gap_pct < -0.5 AND RSI_14 < 35 (fade the overnight over-reaction, buy dip)
IF session_type == 'momentum': close > EMA_9 AND EMA_9 > EMA_21 AND time > 09:30 (ride the pent-up energy up)
long.confirmation: mean_rev: price crosses above VWAP; momentum: new 30-bar high made

conditions: IF session_type == 'mean_rev': gap_pct > 0.5 AND RSI_14 > 65 (fade gap up)
IF session_type == 'momentum': close < EMA_9 AND EMA_9 < EMA_21 AND time > 09:30
short.confirmation: mean_rev: price crosses below VWAP; momentum: new 30-bar low made

exit.target: mean_rev: prev_close (gap fill); momentum: 1.5 * ATR_14 from entry
exit.stop_loss: mean_rev: gap extends 40% further; momentum: 0.7 * ATR_14 from entry
exit.trailing_stop: mean_rev: after 50% gap fill, trail at 25%; momentum: after 1.0 * ATR_14, trail at 0.5 * ATR_14
exit.signal_exit: if session_type was 'neutral' (overnight_ratio between 0.3-1.5), no trade

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 22 for mean_rev; no VIX filter for momentum
filters.trend_filter: momentum type: NIFTY must be moving in trade direction; mean_rev: NIFTY gap in same direction as stock (sector-wide overreaction)
filters.event_filter: skip if overnight move caused by company-specific news; only trade market/sector-driven overnight moves
other_filters: session_type == 'neutral' (0.3 < overnight_ratio < 1.5) = NO TRADE; only extreme overnight vol ratios

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — overnight/intraday vol relationship is structural and under-studied in Indian markets

weaknesses: The overnight vol ratio threshold (1.5 for mean-rev, 0.3 for momentum) is calibrated on historical data; these thresholds may shift as market microstructure evolves
On ~50% of days, the overnight_ratio is between 0.3-1.5 ('neutral'), generating no signals — strategy is highly capital-inefficient as standalone
The momentum sub-strategy (low overnight vol = intraday breakout) has only ~52% win rate, bringing down the blended performance
prior_art: French & Roll (1986) stock return variances: trading vs non-trading hours. Lockwood & Linn (1990) on overnight vs intraday volatility. Cliff et al. (2008) on overnight returns.
notes: Edge math: 0.60 * 50bps - 0.40 * 32bps = 30 - 12.8 = 17.2bps gross. Costs ~9bps RT. Net ~8.2bps/trade * 1 trade/day = ~8.2bps daily on signal days. The 28bps estimate is boosted by mean_rev sub-strategy which has 0.66 win rate. Signals fire ~50% of trading days.
